senses.gloss:
(ङ्) प्रुङ्^1 r. 1st cl. (प्रवते)
To go, to move.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

r. 1st cl. (उ) प्रुषु (प्रोषति)
To burn, to consume with fire.
r. 9th cl. (प्रुष्णाति)
To be unctuous or bland.
2 To sprinkle.
3 To fill.
4 To set free.
5 To be fond of or kind to.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Burnt.
E.
प्रुष to burn, aff. क्त.

m. (-ष्वः)
1 A season of the year, a period of two months.
2 The sun.
f. (-ष्वा)
A drop of water.
E.
प्रुष to burn, Uṇādi aff. क्वन्.
